card: HVAC-ZONE1-MANUAL-OSCILLATION-1 finding_2026_09_26_away_feed_split; HVAC SoP §9.9; decision -> HVAC-WRITE-CONFIRMATION-ORACLE-1
root_cause: The thermostat is physically AWAY (blower 0, temperature rising, config hold away). The Carrier cloud STATUS feed keeps reporting preset home, and URA's S1 trusts preset_mode (status), so it sees 'not at target' and re-writes away every ~10 min. Harm is write churn only. The reload proved the false 'home' comes from the cloud payload, not a stale HA copy.
root_cause_must_mention: status feed says home while config/physical is away
URA trusts preset_mode and re-writes away (churn only)
correct_tier: propose (code / design: which feed confirms a write)
correct_actions: propose_action tier=code: a write-confirmation rule for S1 (decoupled card), without hard-coding hold_activity as the universal oracle
wrong_actions: reload_config_entry ha_carrier again (already shown not to fix it)
invented_evidence_traps: Claiming a human or the Bryant schedule is setting home
Claiming the thermostat is physically cooling to 76
discriminator: A human/schedule writer predicts non-URA rows and a real home (cooling to 76); blower 0 and rising temperature show physical away.
